skill.displayName: AI Amazon Product Dominator — Find Winning Products & Crush the Competition Before You Launch
skill.summary: Scrapes Amazon to identify winning products, analyze competitors, mine negative reviews, calculate profits, craft optimized listings, and create launch videos.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — AI Amazon Product Dominator v1.0.0

- Scrapes Amazon for high-demand, low-competition products with detailed market metrics.
- Analyzes top competitor listings and mines 1-star reviews to find weaknesses and product improvement opportunities.
- Calculates real profit margins, factoring in sourcing, FBA fees, and PPC costs.
- Auto-generates a fully optimized Amazon listing with SEO-driven keywords.
- Develops a keyword-based launch strategy and review/PPC plan.
- Produces a product launch video using InVideo AI for use in listings and ads.
- Powered by Apify, InVideo AI, and Claude AI for a complete Amazon launch intelligence report.
